title: Identity quotient compact-support normalization
statement: For every level n and etale derived object K, the compact-support comparison attached to the identity finite dualizing quotient is the normalized scalar unit at the supported object followed by support applied to the inverse normalized scalar unit at K.

proof.text: Expand the compact-support map into its proper scalar mate and open balancing map. Apply identity normalization of the scalar adjunction, then transport through the proper direct image and open extension factors.
Use the canonical coefficient-unit and witness identifications at the base and on X. Naturality and cancellation of the identity scalar unit give the displayed component equality for every K.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDualizing_compact_support_identity :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n) X),
      Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap (finiteDualizingQuotient l E
          (le_refl n)) (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) K =
        (ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit (Spec (.of D.k)).smallEtaleTopology _
          (finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n)).hom.app
            ((finiteDualizingEtaleSupport l E D X n).obj K) ≫
        (finiteDualizingEtaleSupport l E D X n).map
          ((ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit X.smallEtaleTopology _
            (finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n)).inv.app K)
